name: Kwalasha
storyline:
When meteorites loaded with an unknown substance fell from the sky, the world changed forever. The Empire, absolute ruler of land and sea, tried to control its extraction. But the opportunity to get rich was too tempting. Common people, bandits, opportunists... everyone wanted their share.
In Kwalasha, you step into the shoes of a ruthless pirate captain. Your sole objective: dive into the oceanic abysses where the meteorite's ether remains intact, and loot the wreckage of submarines and imperial ships destroyed by mutant sea creatures.
But this isn't just simple looting. Each expedition is a battle against the unknown..
summary: Kwalasha is a turn-based tactical RPG with a roguelite soul. Recruit the most ruthless, dive into the oceanic abyss, and loot the Empire's wreckage while surviving mutant horrors and deadly decisions.
